title: Basic
description: headers and rows. A column's key is a dot path into each row; numeric end-aligns it with tabular figures, and secondary adds a muted second line. The title names the table.

title: Sorting and selection
description: Sortable headers carry aria-sort and report the next sort through sort-change: sort the rows where they come from. selectable adds row boxes bound to value, with a select-all box that is mixed while some rows are selected.

title: Cells, actions and expansion
description: Cell content comes from a scoped slot per column, given the row; row actions from the actions slot; expanded content from the expansion slot. Status uses a Badge, never a whole-row color.

title: Footer and pagination
description: pagination takes Pagination's props and renders it at the end of the footer. In Livewire, paginated reads a paginator in rows and per-page adds a "Rows per page" Select.
